note: Adapted from Kemner's German original description of 1932. Type locality Maskeliya, Ceylon. The soldier measurement table is blank in the photocopy (only the body length 3.8 mm is legible), so no other measurements can be transcribed and this entry gives the body length only, noting the gap; in the alate measurements the figures of the head-length row are incomplete after OCR, while the head width and the pronotum measurements are legible.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head distinctly longer than wide, cylindrical with parallel sides, slightly flattened above and below; mandibles long and strong, straight, curved only at the apex, not widened at the base; left mandible with 2 teeth before the middle, the posterior one extending a long way backwards, the 3rd tooth projecting very little and extending furthest at the very back; right mandible with 2 large teeth far apart, the position of the teeth varying with the age of the individual. Alate head rounded-oval, rather highly arched above, the frons sloping in front, ocelli small and circular, very close to the compound eyes but not touching them; pronotum large, slightly wider than the head.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dark brown, the antennae, legs and underside paler; wings brown, the costal veins darker. Pilosity sparse, made up of longer and shorter hairs. Head rounded-oval, slightly longer than wide, rather highly arched above, the frons sloping in front; compound eyes small, moderately convex; ocelli small and circular, very close to the compound eyes but not touching them. Antennae short and densely hairy, (15—)16-segmented; segments 2 and 3 equal or segment 2 slightly longer, both cylindrical and equally wide; segment 4 shorter, distinctly narrower at the base. Pronotum large, slightly wider than the head, the anterior margin broadly concave, the posterior margin straight and only slightly concave in the middle. Legs rather short and thick, the tibiae with 3 spurs. Wings very rough, with coarse tubercles. Subcosta of the fore wing almost invisible; radius very short, merging with the anterior margin at the first sixth of the wing (excluding the wing scale); radial sector with about 13 branches towards the anterior margin, the first arising at the first sixth of the wing; media weakly developed, running about midway between the radial sector and the cubitus, giving off very weak anterior branches; cubitus also very weak, running near the middle of the wing and giving off several weak branches towards the posterior margin. Radius of the hind wing also very short, merging with the anterior margin at the first sixth of the wing; radial sector with about 10 branches towards the anterior margin; media and cubitus running as in the fore wing, the cubitus with about 13 weak branches towards the posterior margin. Measurements (mm): body length including the wings 10.50—12.00, body length without the wings 5.50—6.00, fore wing length 8.94—9.62 (excluding the wing scale), 10.56 (including the wing scale), hind wing length 9.04—9.33 (excluding the wing scale), 9.60 (including the wing scale), head width 1.27—1.31, pronotum width 1.38, pronotum length 0.77—0.8 (last digit incomplete in the original).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body yellowish white, the pronotum slightly darker; head yellowish brown, tinged with brown in front; base of the mandibles reddish brown, black towards the apex. Pilosity sparse, the head with only a few isolated setae. Head distinctly longer than wide, cylindrical with parallel sides, slightly flattened above and below; clypeus flat, labrum rounded and less long than wide. Mandibles long and strong, straight, curved only at the apex, not widened at the base; left mandible with 2 teeth before the middle, the posterior one extending a long way backwards, the 3rd tooth projecting very little and extending furthest at the very back; right mandible with 2 large teeth far apart; the positions of the mandibular teeth vary individually, partly with the age of the individual. The underside of the head capsule has a postmental area, extremely narrow behind and strongly widened in front. Antennae short, 14-segmented; segment 1 large, segment 2 less long than wide and about as long as segment 4, segment 3 1.5—2 times as long as segment 2 and slightly thicker; segment 3 is occasionally split and then appears smaller than the neighbouring segments, in which case the antenna may be 15-segmented, but no single complete specimen allows the number to be confirmed; the outer segments are longer than wide, all with hairs and long setae. Pronotum almost twice as wide as long, narrowing backwards, the anterior margin angularly and deeply concave, the posterior margin nearly straight and not or only very slightly concave in the middle. Legs short and thick, the femora only moderately thickened; the fore femur longer than the tibia and slightly more than twice its thickness. Measurements (mm): body length 3.8; the other measurements (head length with the mandibles, head length without the mandibles, head width, pronotum width and length) are not printed in the photocopy of the original and cannot be transcribed.
